verdict.rationale: Zero is an email client, so saved snippets or templates are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents AI-assisted composing, drafts and sending, but nothing about saved snippets, templates, variables or template attachments. AI drafting and saved drafts are adjacent features, not reusable templates, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply
